title: Fem 2d and Fem 3d Structural Analysis Apps
description: Implement two new full-blown Rust apps `fem/2d` and `fem/3d` for finite element structural analysis (displacements, reactions, N/V/M diagrams, stress contours, modal, buckling), plus the greenfield math/solver/meshing kernels they require: `mathematical/sparse` (sparse LDLT, PCG, subspace-iteration eigensolver), RCM ordering in `mathematical/graph`, dense f64 extensions to `mathematical/algebra`, `kernel/2d/mesh` (constrained Delaunay via spade), `kernel/3d/volume` (hex/extrusion/tet-split volumetric meshing), `fem/core` (element trait, formulation toolkit, assembly pipeline, analyses), full 2D/3D element libraries in `fem_2d`/`fem_3d`, and `fem-plugin` (two playground apps, ports 6085/6086, mirroring the `procedural` app template with DocumentApp/ops/undo). Full plan at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/create-new-fullblown-apps-staged-breeze.md. Phased delivery: v0 2D frame/truss linear static, v1 2D continuum + meshing + contours, v2 3D + modal + buckling. Includes workspace wiring (Cargo.toml members, package.json dev scripts, launch.json entries, plugin registry), verification against analytical benchmarks (patch tests, Cook's membrane, Euler buckling, etc.), and identified renderer gaps (Canvas2d triangles layer, World3d clipping/animation/labels) as a follow-up workstream.
summary:
Delivered v0 (the M1 "vertical slice" milestone from the plan): working `fem/2d` and `fem/3d` apps performing real linear-static finite-element structural analysis (frame/truss elements), wired end-to-end into the plugin OS as `fem2d-play` (ports 6086/6186) and `fem3d-play` (ports 6087/6187).

Architecture (bottom-up):
- `mathematical/algebra` extended with f64 dense linear algebra (VecD, MatD with LU solve, Mat3d) needed by the solver.
- `fem/core` (new): generic Element trait, DOF-union assembly, dense elimination solver, reaction/equilibrium checks — dimension-agnostic, reused by both 2D and 3D.
- `fem/2d` (new): Bar2 (truss) + BeamEb2 (Euler-Bernoulli frame) elements, Fem2dDocument with VCS ops/true-inverses/undo (mirrors the procedural2d pattern), fem2d_solve entry point, example fixture.
- `fem/3d` (new): Bar3 (space truss) + Frame3 (3D frame with torsion) elements, Fem3dDocument analogous to 2D, fem3d_solve entry point, example fixture.
- `fem-plugin` (new): fem2d-play/fem3d-play DocumentApp shells — Canvas2d model/results rendering (nodes, members, supports, deformed shape, moment diagrams) for 2D, World3d instanced rendering for 3D, results solved fresh per render (no persisted results, no cache-invalidation surface).

Verification: 70 tests pass across all 5 crates (24 algebra, 6 fem_core, 15 fem_2d, 14 fem_3d, 11 fem-plugin), including two independently hand-derived analytical benchmarks cross-checked against classical solutions before being handed to implementers: simply-supported beam under UDL (45 kN·m midspan moment, 9.617mm deflection, 30kN reactions, all <1% error) and a 3D cantilever tip load (PL³/3EI deflection, PL²/2EI rotation, PL base moment, all <1% error). The fem-plugin wasm32-wasip2 release build was independently verified to compile cleanly. The plugin registry was regenerated and confirms both apps discovered at their assigned ports.

Real bugs found and fixed during implementation (not weakened tolerances): a 3x sign error in BeamEb2's moment/shear station-recovery formula (traced by hand-deriving the exact expected values); a serde gotcha where enum-level `rename_all` doesn't propagate to variant fields, breaking camelCase JSON example-fixture parsing in both fem_2d and fem_3d; two test-fixture "mechanism" bugs correctly identified as genuine structural-determinacy requirements (a 2D truss roller providing zero horizontal restraint on a vertical-only bar; a 3D free joint needing ≥3 non-coplanar bars) rather than solver bugs; a missing `Debug` impl on `fem_core::Model` and a missing `mathematical_algebra` Cargo dependency.

Live browser dev-preview verification: backend fully verified (build + tests + registry), but interactively loading the app in the browser was blocked by an unrelated, in-progress concurrent-session migration renaming `framework/surface/{paint,terrain,tiled-map}` packages — those three haven't been rebuilt under their new names yet, breaking the shared os-shell for every app's dev preview right now, not specific to fem. Root-caused via `ps`/symlink inspection and confirmed via a direct, isolated `cargo build --target wasm32-wasip2 --release` that fem-plugin itself compiles cleanly. Added one legitimate missing symlink for the node-graph package (already rebuilt under its new name by that session) but left the other three untouched since fixing them means completing someone else's in-flight rename. Recommend re-running the dev-preview check (`bun run dev:fem:2d` / `dev:fem:3d`) once that migration lands.

Scope note (per the approved plan's phasing): this is v0 — 2D+3D frame/truss linear static, undo/redo, example fixtures. v1 (continuum elements, meshing, stress contours) and v2 (modal/buckling analysis, richer 3D UX) remain future work under the same goal; the interaction model here is intentionally action-based (not click-to-place gesture tools) for this pass.
